00_READ_ME_FIRST_Project_Overview.title: Career Guidance Project – Telangana (India)
00_READ_ME_FIRST_Project_Overview.sub: Prepared for Goutham Goud – folder-wise project

b.x: A simple folder-wise guide for Telangana students: what to do after 10th, which course, subjects, pass marks, entrance exams and government jobs.

r: MPC, BiPC, MEC, CEC, HEC, Vocational Inter – subjects, marks, pass %. Inside each group: After_12th folder with EVERY eligible degree (own folder + Word file with private & govt jobs). BiPC has full medical: MBBS + all MD/MS/DM/MCh, BDS, AYUSH, nursing, pharmacy, allied health, paramedical, RMP facts
TG POLYCET, 14 diploma branches with year-wise subjects & pass %, agri diplomas, ECET, jobs
Open school (TOSS), apprenticeship, skill courses, other paths
15 govt jobs – each in a separate file with eligibility, age, selection, salary
15 govt exams for any degree (separate files), private jobs by sector, PG entrance exams, 3-yr LLB
Country guides (27), language tests, attestation/apostille, safe emigration (eMigrate, ECR, helplines), study-abroad route, cost planner
TG ePASS, Telangana overseas scholarships (₹20 lakh), central scholarships, education loans, free coaching, helplines
1) Top 10 countries  2) Job search apps by country  3) Step-by-step plan to go abroad

b.x: 10th Pass → Intermediate (2 yrs) → Degree / Engineering / Medical → Jobs / Higher studies
10th Pass → Polytechnic (3 yrs) → Job or B.Tech 2nd year (ECET)
10th Pass → ITI (1–2 yrs) → Apprenticeship → Technical jobs
Inter → Degree (DOST / EAPCET / NEET / LAWCET ...) → Govt exams or private job or PG
10th Pass → Govt jobs directly (GDS, MTS, GD Constable, Agniveer, Railway Group D ...)
ITI: Department of Employment & Training, Telangana
TGPSC: tspsc.gov.in · TGSLPRB: tgprb.in · SSC: ssc.gov.in · Railways: rrbsecunderabad.gov.in
